            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="题解--盲盒流水线">题解 ： 盲盒流水线</h1>
<p><a href="https://h.hszxoj.com/d/hztg/p/P2036?tid=691695338012802efc886824" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">link</a></p>
<p>给定 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个物品，每个物品有价值和质量，<span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 次询问，在 <span class="math inline">\([l , r]\)</span> 中选质量不超过 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 的物品，每个物品至多选一次，并且要让价值最大</p>
<p>$ 1 \leq n \leq 20000$<br>
$ 1 \leq m_i \leq 500$<br>
$ 1 \leq q \leq 100000$</p>
<p>第一眼，这不是背包吗？</p>
<p>暴力：<span class="math inline">\(O(nmq)\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(49pts\)</span></p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int N = 2e4 + 20, mod = 998244353;
int n, v[N], w[N], q, g[N], f[N], p[N];
signed main(){ 
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)cin &gt;&gt; v[i] &gt;&gt; w[i];
    cin &gt;&gt; q;
    for(int qwq = 1, l, r, m, cnt = 0; qwq &lt;= q; ++qwq, cnt = 0){
        cin &gt;&gt; l &gt;&gt; r &gt;&gt; m;
        g[0] = 1;
        for(int i = l; i &lt;= r; ++i){
            for(int j = m; j &gt;= w[i]; --j){
                if(f[j] &lt; f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], g[j] = g[j - w[i]] % mod ;
                else if(f[j] == f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], (g[j] += g[j - w[i]]) %= mod;   
            }
        }
        for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; ++i)(cnt += (f[i] == f[m]) * g[i] % mod) %= mod;
        cout &lt;&lt; f[m] &lt;&lt; ' ' &lt;&lt; cnt &lt;&lt; '\n';
        for(int i = 0; i &lt;= m; ++i)f[i] = g[i] = 0;
    } 
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<p>然后可以上一些数据结构？ 本机房大蛇bjt赛时似乎用一些数据结构优化到了 <span class="math inline">\(66pts\)</span>, 但是我没看懂</p>
<p>我们发现，这个区间会被反复查询导致有重复，由于背包只能加不能删，所以赛时我用回滚莫队优化 <span class="math inline">\(dp\)</span>，单次移动指针是 <span class="math inline">\(O(m)\)</span> 的，最终复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n m \sqrt q)\)</span>， 可以获得 <span class="math inline">\(83pts\)</span></p>
<p>机房大佬 洛阳民宿的 <a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/article/unav5sp5" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">tj</a></p>
<p>赛时代码：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int M = 510, Q = 1e5 + 20, N = 2e4 + 20, mod = 998244353;
int n, qwq, v[N], w[N], B, cnt, L[N], R[N], bel[N], z, g[M], f[M], f_[M], g_[M], Mx[Q];
struct Que{
    int l, r, m, id;
}q[Q];
pair&lt;int,int&gt; ans[Q];
vector&lt;Que&gt;G[Q];
signed main(){
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)cin &gt;&gt; v[i] &gt;&gt; w[i];
    cin &gt;&gt; qwq;
    B = n / (sqrt(qwq) + 1) + 1, cnt = n / B;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= cnt; ++i)L[i] = (i - 1) * B + 1, R[i] = B * i;
    if(R[cnt] &lt; n)++cnt, L[cnt] = R[cnt - 1] + 1, R[cnt] = n;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= cnt; ++i)for(int j = L[i]; j &lt;= R[i]; ++j)bel[j] = i;
    for(int i = 1, l_, r_, m_; i &lt;= qwq; ++i){
        cin &gt;&gt; l_ &gt;&gt; r_ &gt;&gt; m_;
        if(bel[l_] == bel[r_]){
            g[0] = 1;int as = 0, zz = 0;
            for(int i = l_; i &lt;= r_; ++i){
                for(int j = m_; j &gt;= w[i]; --j){
                    if(f[j] &lt; f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], g[j] = g[j - w[i]] % mod ;
                    else if(f[j] == f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], (g[j] += g[j - w[i]]) %= mod;   
                    zz = f[zz] &lt; f[j] ? j : zz;
                }
            }
            for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m_; ++i)(as += (f[i] == f[zz]) * g[i] % mod) %= mod;
            ans[i] = {f[zz], as}; 
            for(int i = 0; i &lt;= m_; ++i)f[i] = g[i] = 0;
        }   
        else G[bel[l_]].push_back({l_, r_, m_, i}), Mx[bel[l_]] = max(m_, Mx[bel[l_]]);
    }
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= cnt; ++i)
        if(G[i].size())sort(G[i].begin(), G[i].end(), [](Que a, Que b){return a.r &lt; b.r;});
    for(int b = 1; b &lt;= cnt; ++b){
        if(!G[b].size())continue;
        memset(g, 0, sizeof(g));memset(f, 0, sizeof(f));
        g[0] = 1;
        int l_ = R[b], r_ = R[b] + 1, zz = 0;
        int mm = Mx[b];
        for(auto [l, r, m, id] : G[b]){
            int as = 0;
            for(int i = r_; i &lt;= r; i++){
                for(int j = mm; j &gt;= w[i]; --j){
                    if(f[j] &lt; f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], g[j] = g[j - w[i]] % mod ;
                    else if(f[j] == f[j - w[i]] + v[i])f[j] = f[j - w[i]] + v[i], (g[j] += g[j - w[i]]) %= mod;   
                }
            }
            r_ = r + 1;
            for(int i = 0; i &lt;= mm; ++i)f_[i] = f[i], g_[i] = g[i]; 
            for(int i = l_; i &gt;= l; --i){
                for(int j = mm; j &gt;= w[i]; --j){
                    if(f_[j] &lt; f_[j - w[i]] + v[i])f_[j] = f_[j - w[i]] + v[i], g_[j] = g_[j - w[i]] % mod ;
                    else if(f_[j] == f_[j - w[i]] + v[i])f_[j] = f_[j - w[i]] + v[i], (g_[j] += g_[j - w[i]]) %= mod;   
                }
            }
            for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; ++i)(as += (f_[i] == f_[m]) * g_[i] % mod) %= mod;
            ans[id] = {f_[m] , as};
            for(int i = 0; i &lt;= mm; ++i)f_[i] = g_[i] = 0;
        }
    }
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= qwq; ++i)cout &lt;&lt; ans[i].first &lt;&lt; ' ' &lt;&lt; ans[i].second &lt;&lt; '\n';   
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<p>由于没有修改操作，我们考虑猫树分治</p>
<p>其实在很早之前一场abc，我了解过猫树分治的说，但是我把他放到任务清单里后就没有再理他。。。</p>
<p>ABC426G，P6240 都是原题</p>
<p>算法大概是这样的：</p>
<p>我们选定当前区间 <span class="math inline">\([l, r]\)</span> 的 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span> ，从 <span class="math inline">\(mid\)</span> 向前向后预处理处理到边界，将左右边界在这个区间内的询问进行处理答案</p>
<p>合并两个背包是 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span> 的，但是我们单纯统计答案，只需要 <code>res = max(res, L[b[i].l][j] + R[b[i].r][b[i].m - j])</code> 就可以 <span class="math inline">\(O(m)\)</span> 的时间内统计答案</p>
<p>时间复杂度应该是 <span class="math inline">\(T(n) = 2T(n / 2) + O(n) = O(n \log n)\)</span></p>
<p>总时间复杂度是 <span class="math inline">\(O(nm \log n + qm)\)</span></p>
<p>关于初始化，我一开始发现将 只将 <code>GL[mid + 1][0]</code> 和 <code>GR[mid][0]</code> 设成<span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>，发现答案会小，把 <code>GL[mid + 1]</code> <code>GR[mid]</code> 都设成 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>, 发现答案会变大</p>
<p>然后，我将 <code>GL[mid + 1][0]</code> 和 <code>GR[mid]</code> 设成 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 就过了，我自己的解释就是说，我们对于左边的只取恰好的，右边的取小于等于的，这样每一种方案只会被统计一次</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int mod = 998244353, N = 2e4 + 20, Q = 1e5 + 20, M = 502;
int n, v[N], w[N], qwq, L[N][M + 20], R[N][M + 20], GL[N][M + 20], GR[N][M + 20];
pair&lt;int, int&gt;ans[Q];
struct Que{
    int l, r, m, id;
}q[Q], b[Q]; 
void solve(int l, int r, int ql, int qr){
    int mid = (l + r) &gt;&gt; 1;
    if(ql &gt; qr)return;
    for(int i = 0; i &lt;= M + 5; ++i)L[mid + 1][i] = 0, GL[mid + 1][i] = !i; 
    for(int i = mid; i &gt;= l; --i){
        for(int j = 0; j &lt;= M; j++){
            GL[i][j] = GL[i + 1][j], L[i][j] = L[i + 1][j];
            if(j &gt;= w[i]){
                if(L[i + 1][j - w[i]] + v[i] &gt; L[i][j])
                    L[i][j] = L[i + 1][j - w[i]] + v[i], GL[i][j] = GL[i + 1][j - w[i]];
                else if(L[i + 1][j - w[i]] + v[i] == L[i][j])(GL[i][j] += GL[i + 1][j - w[i]]) %= mod;
            }
        }
    }
    for(int i = 0; i &lt;= M + 5; ++i)R[mid][i] = 0, GR[mid][i] = 1;
    for(int i = mid + 1; i &lt;= r; ++i){
        for(int j = 0; j &lt;= M; ++j){
            GR[i][j] = GR[i - 1][j], R[i][j] = R[i - 1][j];
            if(j &gt;= w[i]){
                if(R[i - 1][j - w[i]] + v[i] &gt; R[i][j])
                    R[i][j] = R[i - 1][j - w[i]] + v[i], GR[i][j] = GR[i - 1][j - w[i]];
                else if(R[i - 1][j - w[i]] + v[i] == R[i][j])(GR[i][j] += GR[i - 1][j - w[i]]) %= mod;
            }
        }
    }
    int nql = ql, nqr = qr;
    for(int i = ql; i &lt;= qr; ++i)b[i] = q[i];
    for(int i = ql; i &lt;= qr; ++i){
        if(b[i].r &lt; mid)q[nql++] = b[i]; 
        else if(b[i].l &gt; mid)q[nqr--] = b[i];
        else{
            int res = 0, as = 0; 
            for(int j = 0; j &lt;= b[i].m; ++j)
                res = max(res, L[b[i].l][j] + R[b[i].r][b[i].m - j]);
            for(int j = 0; j &lt;= b[i].m; ++j){
                if(res == L[b[i].l][j] + R[b[i].r][b[i].m - j]){
                    (as += 1ll * GL[b[i].l][j] * GR[b[i].r][b[i].m - j] % mod) %= mod;
                }
            }
            ans[b[i].id] = {res, as};
        }
    }
    solve(l, mid, ql, nql - 1), solve(mid + 1, r, nqr + 1, qr);
}
signed main(){
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; ++i)cin &gt;&gt; v[i] &gt;&gt; w[i];
    cin &gt;&gt; qwq;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= qwq; ++i)cin &gt;&gt; q[i].l &gt;&gt; q[i].r &gt;&gt; q[i].m, q[i].id = i;
    solve(1, n, 1, qwq);
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= qwq; ++i){
        if(ans[i].first)cout &lt;&lt; ans[i].first &lt;&lt; ' ' &lt;&lt; ans[i].second &lt;&lt; '\n';
        else cout &lt;&lt; 0 &lt;&lt; ' ' &lt;&lt; 0 &lt;&lt; '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
